items.text: Manual assignments are due when you end them or at a date and time you set. Assign remembers your last choices.
A modification group can get a printed copy of a quiz. Scanned answers join the same results as students on devices.
Editing a quiz after you assign it no longer changes earlier scores. Answer key fixes still apply to unchanged questions.
Assign stays open until the quiz is saved. If saving fails, you see the error and your choices stay.
Stimuli, learning targets and DOK look like the Type field in the question editor.
Open a class's student page from My Classes.
Signing in only asks which Google account to use. You stay signed in until you are away for 30 days.
Pictures and PDFs you upload save to your Google Drive. If Drive is disconnected, you are asked to reconnect.
